title: 'ChiaroScuro' - The Official Trailer of the New Series Premiering at the Rome Film Festival and Coming to Netflix on November 11
summary: The new series starring Pierpaolo Spollon, Andrea Lattanzi, Matilde Gioli, Romana Maggiora Vergano, Aurora Giovinazzo with special appearances by Paz Vega and Alessandro Preziosi.
body_markdown:
###


The official trailer for


#


CHIAROSCURO


###


is out now


#####


The new series starring Pierpaolo Spollon, Andrea Lattanzi, Matilde Gioli, Romana Maggiora Vergano, Aurora Giovinazzo with special appearances by Paz Vega and Alessandro Preziosi


COMING ONLY ON NETFLIX NOVEMBER 11


######


[TRAILER](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DKjB0JPhmYc) |


[KEY ART](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/7d4dfb2f-3f4b-4a94-858c-5eddb9399aa5) |


[IMAGES](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/dad94110-d8dd-4650-ae22-25970dd999b1)


######


Credits: Erika Kuenka/Netflix


October 5, 2026


- The official trailer for


ChiaroScuro


, the new 8-episode light crime series starring


Pierpaolo Spollon, Andrea Lattanzi, Matilde Gioli, Romana Maggiora Vergano


and


Aurora Giovinazzo


, with special appearances by


Paz Vega


and


Alessandro Preziosi


- is out now. The series, a buddy comedy set in the world of art, is produced by Lux Vide, a Fremantle company, and will have its world premiere at the


Rome Film Fest


, out of competition in the Freestyle section, and it’s coming


only on Netflix


on


November 11


.


Cosmo Speranza (


Pierpaolo Spollon


) is the best art advisor in the business. He can tell whether a work of art is genuine or fake from even the smallest detail. An ability that proves useful when he finds himself working with Rome’s Mobile Squad and Inspector Angelo Tiberi (


Andrea Lattanzi


). The two are forced to work side by side, discovering that they make an unlikely yet highly effective investigative duo because, just like a painting, a crime scene can also be a forgery. And no one is better than Cosmo at spotting the clues that can bring down the house of cards built by a killer. But when a painting depicting his childhood home is found at a crime scene, it doesn’t take Cosmo long to realize that the killer is speaking directly to him, prompting him to reopen the investigation into his father’s suicide. A journey between past and present, where it seems impossible to tell truth from fiction.


The series is written by


Umberto Gnoli, Michela Straniero, Francesco Arlanch, Elena Bucaccio


and


Silvia Leuzzi


, and directed by


Jan Maria Michelini


.
